name: STRUCTURAL
meaning: Material portions can be checked from declared architecture structure, identifiers, mappings or versioned configuration.

name: HYBRID
meaning: Structural checks are useful but sufficient assessment also requires interpretation of authority, semantics, behavior, evidence or context.

name: ASSESSMENT
meaning: Accountable judgement is primary; machine checks can support but cannot safely determine the conclusion by themselves.

name: APPLICABLE
meaning: The invariant architectural condition materially arises within the assessed subject/scope.

name: NOT_APPLICABLE
meaning: The condition genuinely does not arise in the bounded scope and that conclusion is justified.

name: UNDETERMINED
meaning: During assessment, applicability itself cannot yet be established.

name: SATISFIED
meaning: The applicable invariant has sufficient evidence to establish satisfaction.

name: VIOLATED
meaning: The applicable invariant is demonstrably violated.

name: INDETERMINATE
meaning: Available evidence cannot establish satisfaction or violation with the confidence required by the invariant.

name: NOT_APPLICABLE
meaning: The invariant condition genuinely does not arise in the bounded scope and the rationale is justified.

name: CONFORMANT
meaning: Every applicable core invariant is SATISFIED; N/A results have justified scope rationale; all obligations required by the claim type are satisfied.

name: NONCONFORMANT
meaning: At least one applicable core invariant is VIOLATED, or a mandatory claim-type obligation is demonstrably violated.

name: INDETERMINATE
meaning: No applicable core invariant is known to be violated, but one or more material applicable obligations cannot be determined with sufficient evidence.

name: Core Architecture Conformance
meaning: The subject preserves all applicable M16 core invariants and the applicable responsibilities/contracts of the HDIP-CLA 0.1 baseline.

name: Profile Conformance
meaning: The subject is Core-conformant and satisfies a named, governed, M16-valid HDIP Profile.

name: Realization Mapping Conformance
meaning: A concrete implementation mapping faithfully realizes the claimed Core/Profile architecture, including traceability to Realization Units, M12 contracts, M13 boundaries/EBCs, evidence responsibilities, currentness and failure/recovery obligations.

name: Enterprise HDIP Architecture
meaning: Enterprise-wide or multi-domain HDIP target/current architecture.

name: Domain / Portfolio HDIP Architecture
meaning: A Data, Information, Intelligence or cross-domain bounded architecture.

name: Governed HDIP Profile
meaning: A concrete enterprise/domain/Product-family/high-assurance/Data-Mesh specialization.

name: Platform / Solution Architecture
meaning: A bounded platform, solution or capability architecture claiming HDIP alignment.

name: Product / Capability Realization Architecture
meaning: A bounded Product or non-Product capability realization using applicable PDEP/SSCF/runtime responsibilities.

name: Concrete Realization Mapping
meaning: The mapping from canonical/Profile architecture into actual deployed/human/provider Realization Units.
